phases.message: Accessorials day. Start in Motive: pull the last two weeks of stops and tell me what you'll need to check for each.
This is the dispatch inbox: rate cons, rep emails, receipts. Read the terms for every load you'll need.
Navisphere. File what CHR owes us, the way CHR checks it, and leave the rest.
Now TQL's dashboard. Same: file what qualifies under TQL's rules.
Uber Freight. Some of these windows are short.
RTS, our factor. Check what actually reached us against what the brokers approved.
Back in the inbox. Invoice what the email-only broker owes, and ask a rep about anything a portal window closed on.

chr_rules.text: One request per stop. The arrival and departure you enter must match the times signed on the BOL, or the request fails validation. Detention is paid per the rate confirmation's free time, rate and cap.
Request a lumper refund within 2 business days of departing the stop, for exactly the amount on the receipt. After that the portal no longer accepts the request; contact your CHR rep.
When you factor, CHR pays linehaul and approved accessorials to your factoring company.

tql_rules.text: Upload anything you want paid under Final Payment Paperwork. The Lumper Receipt category informs your rep only and is not used for payment.
Request detention from the load's Accessorials tab with the BOL in and out times. Terms are those on the rate confirmation.
